title: Core: AS2 for-in loop enumeration
description: Test compilation of for-in loops: for (var k in obj) { trace(k); }, for (var k in arr) { trace(arr[k]); }, for (var k in this) { }. Verify ActionEnumerate2 (0x55) and ActionNextMember (0x19) opcodes. Test for-in with hasOwnProperty guard: for (var k in obj) { if (obj.hasOwnProperty(k)) { ... } }. Test for-in over null/undefined (should compile).
